prompt: Many countries spend large amounts of public money on hosting international sporting events. Some people believe that this money is wasted. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In these days, many countries are spending a huge amount of the public money for hosting the international sporting events like Olympics. Some persons think that this money is wasted. In my opinion, I partly agree with this statement, because there are some benefits also for the host country.

On the one hand, it is true that these events are very expensive. The government has to build the new stadiums, the roads and the accommodation for the athletes, and this cost is very high. After the event is finished, many of these stadiums are remaining empty because the local people do not need such big buildings. Also, the money can be spend on the hospitals and the schools, which are more necessary for the ordinary citizens. So in this way we can say that a lot of this money is wasted.

On the other hand, hosting a big event give many advantages. The country becomes famous in all over the world and more tourists are coming, which is good for the economy. Also the young generation get inspiration from the athletes and they start doing sports, so the health of the nation is improving. Moreover, many people get the jobs during the construction period, and the transport system of the city is also becoming better.

In conclusion, I agree that sometimes the money is wasted when the stadiums are not used after the event, but I also think that the countries are getting many benefits from these events, so it depends on the planning of the government.
title: Whether hosting global sporting events wastes money
